text: dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti . #1 ma. gomā gobhi . navamaṃ paṭhamaāyusuttaṃ [440] evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe . tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavoti . bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ . bhagavā etadavoca appamidaṃ bhikkhave manussānaṃ āyu gamanīyo samparāyo kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ yo bhikkhave ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyoti . [441] atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi dīghamāyu manussānaṃ na naṃ hiḷe suporiso careyya khīramattova natthi maccussa āgamoti . [442] appamāyu manussānaṃ hiḷeyya naṃ suporiso careyyādittasīsova natthi maccussa nāgamoti . atha kho māro pāpimā .pe. tatthevantaradhāyīti . dasamaṃ
